methodology.principle: Use real human demand to decide which useful parts of the living planet to make visible next. Search volume is not invented.
limitations: No Google Search Console property is currently connected through either available GSC connector.
HYPD keyword-volume research is unavailable on the current Free plan.
Bing keyword marketplace data is not configured.

Demand bands are therefore relative hypotheses grounded in public query/SERP patterns, current media relevance, 4PLANET GA4 behaviour and product/source readiness; they are not monthly search-volume claims.

observed4PlanetBaseline.note: GA4 observations include potential internal/test traffic and do not equal verified unique external humans.

methodology.scoring: Positive factors: human demand, right-to-win, visual value, source quality, data availability, graph connectivity, repeat value, brand value. Penalties: production cost, maintenance cost, reputational risk. All factors are 1–5 ordinal scores; opportunityScore is prioritisation only.

masterGoldPilots.why: Best existing combination of human fascination, cleared media, source maturity, observations, ATLAS and Place graph. It can establish the human-first Species standard immediately.
Forces the system to solve a visually iconic place without relying on a generic species template; strong monitoring and heat-signal relationships.
Tests high-repeat discovery and a map-first experience where recency, source dates and interpretation boundaries matter more than prose.
